raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
[by Claude Code]

## Motivation

The cookbook's **Agentic Long-Context Deployment** sections (#42726, #43083, #43799, #43983, #44065, #44228, #44654, #44712, #45039, #45111, #45311, #45513, #45749, #46005, #46506, #46547, #46807, #46948, #47027, #47214, #47303) mirror SemiAnalysis InferenceX AgentX submissions as raw launch commands, each linked to the run that measured it. The configurations are mirrored from SemiAnalysis submissions. This PR:

1. **Syncs to InferenceX `main`** (`ea8b3439`). Three PRs have merged, and their lanes now come from their dashboard runs instead of the PRs:
   - DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash B300 ([InferenceX #4627](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4627), 2026-10-29): `dsv41flash-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-dspark` and `-dspark-lowconc`, previously in progress.
   - MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B300 TP2 ([InferenceX #4524](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4524)), and the shortest-prefill-first TP2 points added on top of it ([InferenceX #4647](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4647), [run 40895671658](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40895671658), append-only on 2026-10-29). Each point is credited to the run that measured it. #47303 had added the #4647 points to the data by hand; they are now generated by the sync.
2. **Adds Muse Spark Open updates** from two in-progress InferenceX PRs:
   - GB200 SGLang, retuned per concurrency ([InferenceX #4670](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4670)).
   - GB300 SGLang, with two new keys, `musespark-fp4-gb300-sglang-agentic-dflash-multinode` and `-dflash-nightly1019` ([InferenceX #4454](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4454), overlaid again after #47214).
3. **Keeps the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 overlays** ([InferenceX #4603](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4603), and [InferenceX #4595](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4595) at its new head) and the Qwen3.5 GB300 overlay ([InferenceX #4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333)).

## Source

[InferenceX](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX) `main` (`ea8b3439`), with these InferenceX PRs overlaid:

| PR | Page | Lanes | Pinned to |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#4670](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4670) Muse Spark Open GB200 SGLang, retuned per concurrency | Muse Spark Open | `musespark-fp4-gb200-sglang-agentic-dflash` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `5692839d` |
| [#4454](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4454) Muse Spark Open NVFP4 GB300 SGLang | Muse Spark Open | new `musespark-fp4-gb300-sglang-agentic-dflash-multinode`, `-dflash-nightly1019` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `a73b274a` |
| [#4603](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4603) DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 SGLang, `20261029` nightly, TP4 c1 megakernel | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-sglang-agentic-dspark` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `9bd047ac` |
| [#4595](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4595) DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang, bonus-fixed nightlies | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `-dspark-disagg-hicache`; retires `-dspark-disagg` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `4145e263` |
| [#4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333) Qwen3.5 NVFP4 GB300 Dynamo+SGLang | Qwen3.5 | `qwen3.5-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `-disagg`; retires `-agg-pareto`, `-pp-pareto` | [run 39355392627](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39355392627), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333#issuecomment-6334247978) (head `02b72dc0`, unchanged), verified |

"In progress" lanes are rendered at the PR head and labeled "In progress in SA InferenceX AgentX". A later sync pins them once the PR gets a `/use` run or merges.

- **DeepSeek-V4 page unchanged.** [InferenceX #4664](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4664) retired DeepSeek-V4-Pro from active benchmarks: InferenceX `main` no longer has `dsv4-*` keys, though the published results remain. This PR does not touch `deepseek-v4.jsx`. Its section keeps the launches #47214 put live (InferenceX `main` `70a76017` and [InferenceX #4556](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556)'s `/use` run), each still linked to the run that measured it. Later refreshes will not update it.
- **No longer overlaid:**
  - DeepSeek-V4-Pro B200 disagg ([InferenceX #4556](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4556)): its model was retired, see above.
- **Retired keys (as in #47214):**
  - [InferenceX #4595](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4595) deletes `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-dspark-disagg` and replaces it with `-dspark-disagg-hicache`.
  - [InferenceX #4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333) deletes `qwen3.5-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg-pareto` and `-pp-pareto`.
- **Not mirrored (unmeasured, unchanged):** `musespark-fp4-h100-sglang-agentic-dflash` and `qwen3.5-fp8-h100-sglang-agentic`. The dashboard has no rows for them.
- InferenceX `main` was frozen for this PR at `ea8b3439`. Later merges are left for the next refresh.

## What this PR does

| Page | Lanes | Deployments | Points | Hardware |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MiniMax-M3.1 | 4 | 19 (17 in #47214) | 65 (59 in #47214) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200 |
| GLM-5.2 | 14 | 34 | 75 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| GLM-5.3 | 1 | 1 | 10 | B300 |
| DeepSeek-V4 | unchanged | | | |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 | 10 | 21 | 65 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.5 | 16 | 51 | 220 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 5 | 24 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |
| Muse Spark Open | 8 (was 6) | 11 (was 9) | 70 (was 66) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |

- No new keep / remove rules were needed. The GLM-5.2, GLM-5.3, Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next data change only in their shared source block (the InferenceX `main` SHA and the overlay list).

## Validation

- **Browser checks:** every page this PR changes was rendered in a headless browser (`mint dev`, Mintlify as in CI).
  - Every hardware / checkpoint / deployment / concurrency / KV tier / router combination renders exactly the decoded commands: 2,868 command sets, 0 mismatches, 0 unseen, no browser errors.
  - Every tab was clicked, and every "Copy link" URL was reopened.
  - The section links from the Deployment panels (DeepSeek-V4 included) and the copy buttons were also checked.
- **Decode and KV-flag checks:**
  - The component's own decoder reproduces every generated plan (2,868 router × KV-tier variants).
  - Every KV flag exists in its image's SGLang commit (218 image × flag pairs).
  - The round-trip / leak check reports 0 problems.
- **Arg-parse in the submission images:** all 96 commands not validated in an earlier round parse with their image's own parsers:

  | Image | Commands |
  |---|---|
  | `dev-minimax-m31-flash` | 36 |
  | `nightly-dev-20261026-8252e3af` | 48 |
  | `nightly-dev-cu13-20261020-ab580b2e` | 12 |

  The amd64 and arm64 builds of each nightly come from the same SGLang commit.
- `node scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`, `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects`, `mint validate` and `pre-commit run --all-files` (in `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13`) pass.
